decision.observation: The light-blue sheet is gone from the inspection area; the dark area is empty with 'DRAG DOCUMENTS HERE'. A small white sheet is back in the bottom-left tray with the cursor hand on it. A white ring icon appeared on the shutter box above the desk.
decision.hypothesis: The document was returned to the tray unstamped; the white ring is the speaker/call button. Clicking it calls the next entrant so the day can proceed.
